recommendations.text: Replace the upload retry's fixed two-second delay with exponential backoff with jitter.
Preserve the existing five-attempt limit and its counting semantics; do not schedule a retry delay after the final failed attempt.

Proposed delay policy: before retry number r, starting at r = 1, choose a delay uniformly from zero to 2,000 × 2^(r−1) milliseconds. No separate delay cap is proposed because the attempt limit bounds the sequence.

Add a deterministic test that performs no real sleeping. Control the randomness and replace or fake the wait mechanism so the test verifies exponential delay bounds, jitter application, the five-attempt limit, and no further retries after success or exhaustion.
Keep existing retry eligibility, upload behavior, and terminal error handling unchanged; broader retry-policy redesign is out of scope.
Verify the added test and existing suite using the repository's configured npm test command.
